description.from:
## Behavior
As a human or agent author, I can combine effects into coherent VideoML scenes.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given catalog components, when following recipes for pacing, easing, stagger, hierarchy, holds, and transitions, then complete runnable examples demonstrate the intended result. Publish a visual-only showcase and guidance on mixing compatible frameworks; show optional standard VideoML narration through Auritus alongside visual-only examples.

## Ownership
toolchain, videoml-org, player; Babulus integration

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
